list.name: site
list.label: Site
list.query:
import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"
schema.tagValues(bucket: "environment_raw", tag: "site", start: -30d,
  predicate: (r) => r._measurement == "environment" and r.room_type != "unregistered")

list.name: room_type
list.label: Room type
list.query:
import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"
schema.tagValues(bucket: "environment_raw", tag: "room_type", start: -30d,
  predicate: (r) => r._measurement == "environment" and r.room_type != "unregistered" and contains(value: r.site, set: ${site:json}))

list.name: room
list.label: Room
list.query:
import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"
schema.tagValues(bucket: "environment_raw", tag: "room", start: -30d,
  predicate: (r) => r._measurement == "environment" and r.room_type != "unregistered" and contains(value: r.site, set: ${site:json}) and contains(value: r.room_type, set: ${room_type:json}))

panels.title: Current conditions
panels.description: Latest reading per sensor, worst first. 'Why' explains any Watch or Alarm. See 'Alarm rules and target ranges' below.

targets.query:
import "math"
f = (c) => c * 1.8 + 32.0
r0 = (x) => string(v: int(v: math.round(x: x)))
r1 = (x) => string(v: math.round(x: x * 10.0) / 10.0)
from(bucket: "environment_raw")
  |> range(start: -30d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "environment")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r._field, set: ["temperature_c", "humidity_rh", "dew_point_c", "status", "t_status", "rh_status", "t_min_c", "t_max_c", "rh_min", "rh_max"]))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.site, set: ${site:json}))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.room_type, set: ${room_type:json}))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.room, set: ${room:json}))
  |> last()
  |> toFloat()
  |> group()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time", "building", "floor", "room", "room_type", "sensor_id"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => {
      tw = if not exists r.t_status then "" else if r.t_status == 0.0 then ""
           else if r.temperature_c > r.t_max_c then "Too warm: " + r1(x: f(c: r.temperature_c)) + " °F, max " + r0(x: f(c: r.t_max_c)) + " °F"
           else "Too cold: " + r1(x: f(c: r.temperature_c)) + " °F, min " + r0(x: f(c: r.t_min_c)) + " °F"
      hw = if not exists r.rh_status then "" else if r.rh_status == 0.0 then ""
           else if r.humidity_rh > r.rh_max then "Too humid: " + r1(x: r.humidity_rh) + " %, max " + r0(x: r.rh_max) + " %"
           else "Too dry: " + r1(x: r.humidity_rh) + " %, min " + r0(x: r.rh_min) + " %"
      return {status: r.status, building: r.building, floor: r.floor, room: r.room, room_type: r.room_type,
        temp_f: f(c: r.temperature_c),
        t_target: if exists r.t_min_c then r0(x: f(c: r.t_min_c)) + "–" + r0(x: f(c: r.t_max_c)) + " °F" else "none",
        humidity_rh: r.humidity_rh,
        rh_target: if exists r.rh_min then r0(x: r.rh_min) + "–" + r0(x: r.rh_max) + " %" else "none",
        dew_f: f(c: r.dew_point_c),
        why: if tw != "" and hw != "" then tw + "; " + hw else if tw != "" then tw else if hw != "" then hw else "In range",
        age_min: float(v: int(v: now()) - int(v: r._time)) / 60000000000.0, sensor_id: r.sensor_id}
    })
  |> sort(columns: ["building", "floor", "room"])

panels.title: Status history by room
panels.description: Worst status in each time slice. Long amber or red bars show sustained excursions.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "environment_raw")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "environment" and r._field == "status")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.site, set: ${site:json}))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.room_type, set: ${room_type:json}))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.room, set: ${room:json}))
  |> group(columns: ["building", "room"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: max, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r._value, _field: r.building + " · " + r.room}))
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])

panels.title: Leaks and air quality
panels.description: Latest state of water-leak probes and air-quality sensors. Limits: see 'Alarm rules and target ranges' on the Overview.

targets.query:
import "math"
import "strings"
r0 = (x) => string(v: int(v: math.round(x: x)))
base = from(bucket: "environment_raw")
  |> range(start: -30d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.site, set: ${site:json}))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.room_type, set: ${room_type:json}))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.room, set: ${room:json}))
  |> last()
  |> toFloat()
leak = base
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "leak" and r._field == "water")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({building: r.building, floor: r.floor, room: r.room, sensor_id: r.sensor_id, kind: "Water leak",
      status: r._value * 2.0, reading: if r._value > 0.0 then "WATER DETECTED" else "Dry",
      why: if r._value > 0.0 then "Water at the probe: check now" else "Dry"}))
air = base
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "air_quality")
  |> group()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["building", "floor", "room", "sensor_id"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => {
      w = (if exists r.pm25_status and r.pm25_status > 0.0 then "PM2.5 above " + r0(x: if r.pm25_status > 1.0 then 25.0 else 10.0) + "; " else "") + (if exists r.pm10_status and r.pm10_status > 0.0 then "PM10 above " + r0(x: if r.pm10_status > 1.0 then 50.0 else 20.0) + "; " else "") + (if exists r.co2_ppm_status and r.co2_ppm_status > 0.0 then "CO2 above " + r0(x: if r.co2_ppm_status > 1.0 then 2000.0 else 1000.0) + "; " else "") + (if exists r.voc_index_status and r.voc_index_status > 0.0 then "VOC index above " + r0(x: if r.voc_index_status > 1.0 then 300.0 else 200.0) + "; " else "") + (if exists r.nox_index_status and r.nox_index_status > 0.0 then "NOx index above " + r0(x: if r.nox_index_status > 1.0 then 100.0 else 20.0) + "; " else "")
      rd = (if exists r.pm25 then "PM2.5 " + r0(x: r.pm25) + " µg/m³" else "") + " · " + (if exists r.pm10 then "PM10 " + r0(x: r.pm10) + " µg/m³" else "") + " · " + (if exists r.co2_ppm then "CO2 " + r0(x: r.co2_ppm) + " ppm" else "") + " · " + (if exists r.voc_index then "VOC index " + r0(x: r.voc_index) + "" else "") + " · " + (if exists r.nox_index then "NOx index " + r0(x: r.nox_index) + "" else "")
      return {building: r.building, floor: r.floor, room: r.room, sensor_id: r.sensor_id, kind: "Air quality", status: r.status,
        reading: strings.trim(v: strings.replaceAll(v: rd, t: " ·  · ", u: " · "), cutset: " ·"),
        why: if w == "" then "In range" else strings.trimSuffix(v: w, suffix: "; ")}
    })
union(tables: [leak |> group(), air])
  |> sort(columns: ["building", "floor", "room", "kind"])

panels.title: Temperature (°F)
panels.description: Mean per group. Use 'Group by' to compare rooms, room types, floors or buildings.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "environment_raw")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "environment" and r._field == "temperature_c")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.site, set: ${site:json}))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.room_type, set: ${room_type:json}))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.room, set: ${room:json}))
  |> group(columns: if "${group_by}" == "room" then ["building", "room"] else ["${group_by}"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: r._value * 1.8 + 32.0}))
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r._value, _field: if "${group_by}" == "room" then r.building + " · " + r.room else string(v: r["${group_by}"])}))
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])

options.content:
**How status is decided.** Each room is compared with the target range for its room type.

- **OK**: inside the target range.
- **Watch**: up to 1.8 °F or 5 % RH outside the range. A notification is sent if it lasts 1 hour.
- **Alarm**: further outside than that. A high-priority notification is sent if it lasts 10 minutes.
- **Sensor offline**: no reading for 15 minutes.
- Also notified: **mould risk** (RH above 65 % for 48 h), **large daily RH swing** (more than the room type allows), and a **stuck sensor** (no change in 6 h).

| Room type | Temperature target | RH target | Max RH swing / 24 h |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| General storage (stacks, map room) | 55–68 °F | 35–50 % | ±5 % |
| Vault | 55–64 °F | 35–45 % | ±5 % |
| Cold room | 36–46 °F | 30–40 % | ±5 % |
| Humidification room | 59–77 °F | 60–95 % | — |
| Freezer | -4–5 °F | 30–40 % | ±5 % |

Targets follow ISO 11799 / BS EN 16893 practice. Admins and Editors change them on the **Settings** dashboard.

**Water leak probes**: any water = Alarm, notified at once.  **Air quality** (Watch above / Alarm above; notified after 2 h / 30 min): PM2.5 10 / 25 µg/m³; PM10 20 / 50 µg/m³; CO2 1000 / 2000 ppm; VOC index 200 / 300; NOx index 20 / 100.
